ns2:section.sectionText: This section will meet on the following dates: June 21-23, 28-30, July 12-13, 2016. 1:30-7:30 PM. Center for Innovation in Teaching & Learning (CITL) restrictions and assessments apply, see https://online.illinois.edu. This course is part of a self-supporting program and DOES NOT accept the following tuition and fee waivers (TFWs): Cooperating Teacher waivers, Non-Academic waivers (including UIUC employees and employees of other state institutions), Academic waivers from UIUC, UIC and UIS employees, Related Agency waivers, Field Supervisor waivers, waivers granted through fellowships/assistantships as governed by the Graduate College at UIUC, or Retiree waivers. This program DOES accept statutory waivers (veterans grants, etc.).
